description: Reads about the developer's own domain, on their Cloudflare, and the mail of that domain. Omit projectId for the account's. "list": the domains and their state. "registration" { domain }: who registers it and when it expires, and transferStartBy (17 days before the expiry). "transfer_check" { domain }: transferable or not, why, and the price (a year is added); the transfer itself needs the auth code, which the developer enters in the panel (panelUrl); this tool does not take it. "check_new" { domains: [...] }: free or taken and the price (Cloudflare's). "mail_status" { domain }: the mail forwarding of the domain. "check" { domain }: asks Cloudflare whether the nameservers changed (Neblla also watches, and emails the developer when it is active). Changes nothing; neblla_domains adds, points, buys and forwards.
name: neblla_domains_read
title: Domains (read)
